Definition
[$(\gamma ,A)$-regular function] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0368 1. ch26:26.20\group Weighted Heat Estimates

A continuous strictly increasing (f:$0,T]\to (0,\infty )$ is $(\gamma ,A)$-regular, where $\gamma >1$ and $A\ge 1$, if \[ \frac{f(\tau _1)}{f(\tau _1/\gamma )}\le A\frac{f(\tau _2)}{f(\tau _2/\gamma )} \quad (0<\tau _1\le \tau _2<T). \]
